stemMd: A sealed box weighs 860 g. After half of its contents are removed, it weighs 500 g. What is the mass of the empty box?
explanationMd: The removed half of the contents weighs 860 − 500 = 360 g, so the full contents weigh 720 g. Subtracting from the original total gives empty-box mass 860 − 720 = 140 g. Check: 140 + 360 = 500.

distractorRationale.d: This does not satisfy both weight observations.
distractorRationale.b: This is the mass of contents removed, not the box.
distractorRationale.c: This halves the total initial mass, including the box.
distractorRationale.a: This is the initial mass of the contents.
